evidence_basis: Current inventory, eight text-grounded cases, primary ambiguity/conflict research

dimensions.review_status: Existing claim review status; never overwritten by retrieval score
dimensions.ambiguity_status: Existing free-form issue note; not a contradiction verdict

candidate_triage.exact_source_or_quote_overlap: Prioritize mapping to reviewed claims; do not automatically equate propositions
candidate_triage.partial_overlap: Check whether uncovered text adds a distinct condition, exception or claim
candidate_triage.no_reviewed_quote_on_passage: Read latest passage ledger and source context; not proof of missing knowledge
candidate_triage.extracted_fragment: Join semantic continuation with full source spans before assessing
candidate_triage.technically_informative: Review complete proposition, attribution and applicability before publication
candidate_triage.context_or_rhetoric: Preserve searchable original as context without forcing a universal rule
candidate_triage.unsupported_or_unknown_source: Keep evidence limitation and existing status

resolution_requirements.context_separation: Conditions and meanings need actual source evidence; mere invented conditions cannot resolve a tension
resolution_requirements.logical_conflict_candidate: Align object, term sense, level, completion state, time, polarity, quantifier and applicability before recording opposing propositions
resolution_requirements.revision: Explicit textual evidence required; later date alone is insufficient
resolution_requirements.inference_publication: Use a separate inferred claim with reviewed premises and curation checks; do not replace original explicit wording
resolution_requirements.source_repair: Verify page image and mapping before correcting source wording or attribution
resolution_requirements.duplication: Source-span overlap is a prioritization signal, not semantic identity

generation_contract: Return useful source information even if a unique formal rule cannot be established
State supported interpretations and their conditions separately
Distinguish author wording, research interpretation and engineering assumption
Retrieve alternative evidence when a known issue would otherwise be represented by one branch only
Report missing evidence and context budgets; absence of a retrieved counterexample is not proof of no counterexample
Do not resolve by source repetition, model agreement, similarity score or recency alone
release_gates: Every interpretation links to real stable source IDs
Conditions, exceptions and qualifier words survive evidence packaging
Opposition detection and opposition resolution are evaluated separately
New semantic publications preserve canonical history and existing evidence
